subject: general
question: Which of the following is a wildlife sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manas Wildlife Sanctuary:**

 
 
• It is a national park, a **Project Tiger reserve**, an elephant reserve and a biosphere reserve in Assam.
 
• It is home to rare and endangered endemic wildlife such as the Assam roofed turtle, hispid hare, golden langur and pygmy hog.
 
• The Manas National Park was declared a sanctuary in **1928**.
 
• It was included in the list of **UNESCO World Heritage Sites in 1985**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pachmarhi is a hill station in the Hoshangabad district of Madhya Pradesh.

 
 
• Pachmarhi, widely known as the Queen of Satpura, is situated at an altitude of 1100 meters in the valley of the Satpura range in the Hoshangabad district.
 
• The name Panchmarhi is believed to be derived from the Hindi words Panch ("five") and Marhi ("caves").
 
• These caves were built by the five Pandava brothers of the Mahabharata period during their thirteen years of exile.
 
 
 
• **Sundarban National Park** is located in West Bengal.
 
 
• The park is listed on the UNESCO world heritage site.
 
• Sundarban National Park is famous for Royal Bengal Tigers.
 
• It is a large coastal mangrove forest.
 
• **Sundarban delta** is the largest delta in the world.
 
 
 
• **Nilgiri Hills **are situated in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
• Doddabetta is the highest peak of the Nilgiri hills.
 
• Nilgiri hills are a part of the Western Ghats.
 
• The hills are located at the tri-junction of the states Karnataka, Kerela, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• These mountains are named after the Neelakurunji flowers (purplish-blue flowers) found in the Shola forests of Nilgiri hills.
 
• Nilgiri Hills are known as the Blue Mountains.
